description: This file defines a custom report class for generating user timesheet reports in Odoo, including functions for date calculations, XML report creation, and data aggregation from analytic accounts and user info.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class for generating user timesheet XML reports, inheriting from report_rml.

methods.name: get_month_name
methods.description: Returns the localized name of a given month number.

methods.name: get_weekday_name
methods.description: Returns the localized abbreviation of a weekday number.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of user timesheet data for a specified month and user.
